front: What happened at Altena Farm on 21 December 1972?
back: A ZANLA attack in the Centenary district that opened the north-eastern front and began the second phase.
An all-night political meeting held by guerrillas with villagers.
Young male (mujibha) and female (chimbwido) helpers of the guerrillas: messengers, lookouts, carriers.
A fenced, guarded village into which rural people were moved to cut them off from guerrillas.

front: Give the dates of the raids on Nyadzonia, Chimoio and Freedom Camp.
back: Nyadzonia 9 August 1976; Chimoio 23 November 1977; Freedom Camp 19 October 1978.

front: When was the Patriotic Front formed?

back: ZANLA gained bases along the whole eastern border, spreading the war across the country.

front: Who supported ZANLA and ZIPRA from outside Africa?
back: China supported ZANLA; the Soviet Union supported ZIPRA.
Protected villages, collective fines and curfews, cross-border raids, the Selous Scouts and martial law.
